summary: Explosions have been reported in multiple locations in Iran, including a radar site in Tabriz and an explosion in Ahvaz. In Gaza, Israeli airstrikes killed two Hamas operatives involved in funneling funds from Iran and Turkey and destroyed three weapon depots. Suspected Israeli airstrikes in Iraq targeted militia warehouses storing air defense systems transferred from Iran.
key_points: An explosion occurred at a radar site in Tabriz, southwest of the city in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran, at 13:39 local time (1009Z), reported with a 120-second delay via FromIran. (Source: @shin_persian/11493)
An explosion sound was heard in Ahvaz, around the Chaharshir neighborhood in Khuzestan Province, Iran, indicating a possible targeted incident. (Source: @shin_persian/11488)

Iran opened shelters at its 1st Air Base in Tehran, with fighter jet activity observed at the base and over East Azerbaijan Province, suggesting heightened military readiness. (Source: @shin_persian/11499, @shin_persian/11496, @shin_persian/11497)

Israeli airstrikes killed two Hamas operatives in Gaza City and Nuseirat who were transferring millions of shekels from Iran and Turkey to Hamas's military wing, aiding in rebuilding capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59421)
Israel bombed three Hamas weapon depots in the central Gaza Strip, containing Kalashnikov rifles, rockets, and a rocket launcher, in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59421)

Iraqi officials suspect Israel carried out airstrikes against two warehouses storing Chinese-made air defense systems recently transferred from Iran to Tehran-backed militias, destroying a large shipment. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8855)
Israel conducted artillery fire towards southern Lebanon, amid reports of ongoing tensions on the northern border. (Source: @yediotnews25/136731)
Turkey announced plans to produce 5 million kamikaze drone systems within five years and 10 million within a decade, expanding its unmanned warfare capabilities. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8856)

points: At 13:39 local time (1009Z), an explosion occurred at a radar site in Tabriz, located southwest of the city in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran. The incident was reported via FromIran with a 120-second delay, indicating a targeted strike on military infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/11493)

An explosion sound was heard in Ahvaz, around the Chaharshir neighborhood in Khuzestan Province, Iran, suggesting another possible sabotage or attack event in a key industrial region. (Source: @shin_persian/11488)

The IRIAF 1st Air Base shelters were opened in Tehran, Tehran Province, Iran, as a defensive measure against potential threats, with fighter jet activity observed at the base. (Source: @shin_persian/11499, @shin_persian/11496)

Jet activity was detected over East Azerbaijan Province, Iran, following the explosions in Tabriz, possibly indicating Iranian military scrambling or readiness responses. (Source: @shin_persian/11497)

An additional explosion was reported in western Tabriz at 1232Z (16:02 local time) in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran, further highlighting the intensity of incidents in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/11500)

The Israeli Navy conducted a joint drill with the Hellenic Navy in the Mediterranean, involving missile boats and practicing operational scenarios such as identifying and thwarting maritime threats and sinking enemy vessels. (Source: @manniefabian/59419)
An Israeli GLF5 aircraft was tracked over Palestine conducting SIGINT missions, intercepting communications as part of electronic intelligence gathering. (Source: @redlinkleb/49841)

Israeli airstrikes killed Alaa Ibrahim Nimer Arshi, a cell commander in Hamas's military wing, in Gaza City, and Karam Riyad Hassan Abu Butaihan, a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative, in Nuseirat. Both were involved in transferring millions of shekels from Iran and Turkey to Hamas's military wing. (Source: @manniefabian/59421)

Israel bombed three Hamas weapon depots in the central Gaza Strip, which stored various weapons including Kalashnikov rifles, rockets, and a rocket launcher, as part of efforts to dismantle Hamas's military infrastructure. (Source: @manniefabian/59421)
Reports from Lebanon indicate that Israel conducted artillery fire towards the southern part of the country, amid ongoing tensions and potential cross-border incidents. (Source: @yediotnews25/136731)

Iraqi officials suspect Israel carried out airstrikes against two warehouses storing Chinese-made air defense systems recently transferred from Iran to Tehran-backed militias, destroying a large shipment and following a series of explosions targeting militia weapons depots around Baghdad since October 1. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8855)

Turkey aims to produce 5 million kamikaze drone systems within five years and 10 million within a decade, as announced by Chief of General Staff Gen. Selçuk Bayraktaroğlu, outlining plans to dramatically expand the country's unmanned warfare capabilities. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8856)
